diagnosis: The Lambda handler receives requests where the API Gateway custom authorizer generated and cached a wildcard resource policy. The handler assumes the authorizer validated tenantId, and queries DynamoDB solely using the path parameter tenantId without asserting that authorizer context tenantId matches event.pathParameters.tenantId.
exploit_request:
GET /audit-logs/tenant_target_finance_corp HTTP/1.1
Host: logs.apigateway.aws.com
Authorization: Bearer <valid_jwt_different_tenant>
